print_note: Visible face DOWN, bosses UP. PETG, 0.15 mm layers, supports OFF. Install two M3 × 4 inserts in these upper bosses; use two existing M3 × 8 screws from underneath.

name: Print FIRST: lower joint sample v5
print_note: Black PETG, cups UP, supports OFF. M3 × 8 screws enter upward through the short mounting shelves. Test the wired LED through the 10 × 4 mm slots.

name: Print FIRST: joystick corner v5
print_note: Flat visible face DOWN; PETG, 0.10 mm layers, supports OFF. Pair with the separate v5 adapter. Uses two M1.6 × 10 screws and exposed existing M1.6 nuts.

name: Print FIRST / reuse: joystick adapter v5
print_note: PETG, 0.10 mm layers. Pegs DOWN, ear seats UP. Support UNDER the base between pegs; keep holes and seats clear. Remove supports, check it sits flat. Reuse this tested piece in final keyboard.

name: 01 case
print_note: Open side up; supports in USB tunnel only if your slicer needs them.

print_note: New matching v5 lower tray. Black PETG, cups UP, supports OFF. Four existing M3 × 8 screws enter from below into the upper plate. Preserve 10 × 4 mm LED slots and wire slack. Test samples first.

name: 03 round foot
print_note: Flat bottom DOWN. Washer pockets face up; secure washers with tape before assembly.

name: 05 touch cap
print_note: Visible face DOWN. Bond 13 mm copper disk immediately beneath the 0.8 mm top skin.

name: 06 encoder knob
print_note: Socket DOWN; short bridging above nut pocket. Trial fit the D socket before pressing fully. Adhesive optional after testing.

name: 08 keycap 1u
print_note: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim. Print 6 clear and 5 white, top UP; 0.10-0.12 mm layers with a 0.4 mm nozzle. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Test one cap first.

name: 09 keycap 2u dual stem
print_note: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim; white PETG, top UP. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Two MX sockets 19.05 mm apart; fits two switches, not a centered stabilizer. Test fit first.

name: 10 switch fit coupon
print_note: Left/middle/right from top: 14.0 / 14.1 / 14.2 mm. Choose snug clip fit before full print.

name: 11 stem insert coupon
print_note: Cross fits -0.05 / nominal / +0.05, then 3.9 mm insert pocket. Sockets UP for inspection.
